14.20.title: Radiometer Antenna Temperature Sensitivity
14.20.title_cn: 辐射计天线温度灵敏度证明
14.20.description: Consider the radiometer antenna shown below, where the antenna is at a physical temperature $T_p$ and has a radiation efficiency $\eta_{\text{rad}}$, and an impedance mismatch $\Gamma$ at its terminals. If $T_S$ is the apparent temperature seen by the radiometer, show that $\Delta T_S / \Delta T_{\text{true}}$ is equal to the product of radiation efficiency and mismatch loss, by applying two background temperatures, $T_B = T_p$ and $T_B = T_2 \neq T_p$.
14.20.description_cn: 考虑下图所示的辐射计天线，天线物理温度为 $T_p$，辐射效率为 $\eta_{\text{rad}}$，终端存在阻抗失配 $\Gamma$。若 $T_S$ 为辐射计测得的表观温度，通过施加两个背景温度 $T_B = T_p$ 和 $T_B = T_2 \neq T_p$，证明 $\Delta T_S / \Delta T_{\text{true}}$ 等于辐射效率与失配损耗的乘积。
